citation.title: High Resolution Main-ion Charge Exchange Spectroscopy in the DIII-D H-mode Pedestal
citation.authors: B. A. Grierson, K. H. Burrell, C. Chrystal, R. J. Groebner, S. R. Haskey, D. H. Kaplan
citation.pages: 11E545 (per record hint; not printed in extracted text)
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1063/1.4960604 (record hint; not verified in extracted text)

topic: Instrumentation and first profiles from DIII-D edge main-ion (deuterium) CER with interleaved carbon impurity sightlines.
own_question: Can a tangential, interleaved main-ion and impurity CER system resolve pedestal main-ion Ti, rotation, CX emission and beam emission?
actual_method_and_evidence: Sixteen deuterium and nineteen impurity sightlines are interleaved, giving 8 mm inter-channel spacing. Spectra use typical 2.5 ms integration, with 200 µs stated as possible. Analysis uses beam-modulation background subtraction and offline multi-component spectral fitting. Results come from one ELMy H-mode discharge. In that discharge, carbon and deuterium Ti agree in the core but deviate near the separatrix. Main-ion rotation is about twice the carbon rotation at the separatrix.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In one DIII-D H-mode example, carbon-impurity and main-ion CER temperatures diverged near the separatrix. This supports describing our carbon CES label as species-specific rather than a generic ion temperature.
claim_checks.qualification: The evidence is a single discharge on a different device (DIII-D, not KSTAR). The authors report a deviation, not a quantified bias.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: CER ion profiles are produced by offline spectral fitting with background subtraction and edge-specific assumptions on level populations. This makes reported CES values model-processed labels.
claim_checks.qualification: The source describes DIII-D analysis choices; KSTAR processing may differ. Report latency is not stated.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Gives integration times only. It does not give report arrival or analysis latency. It involves no BES/ECEI inputs and no nowcasting.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim KSTAR carbon CES temperature equals main-ion temperature or is biased by a known amount.
Do not treat 200 µs integration as real-time report availability.
Do not cite this source as evidence for BES/ECEI-based estimation.
Do not generalize the factor-of-two rotation difference to temperature or to KSTAR.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include it as background on what CES labels represent: impurity versus main-ion differences and fitted-label processing. Keep the citation brief and do not use it for methods or timing.
